N 160049 ZRY approved with modifications by City Council 2016-03-22 (Land Use Committee 2016-03-17). No separate effective date found; text amendments normally take effect on adoption. Wave year 2016.

Inside the Transit Zone: no parking required for new income-restricted housing units incl. MIH units (ZR 25-251) or affordable independent residences for seniors (ZR 25-252). Existing AIRS may drop parking as of right; existing IRHU parking removable by BSA special permit (ZR 73-433). Mixed-income buildings: only discretionary relief, BSA 73-435 (>=20% IRHU plus 30% other rent-restricted) or CPC 74-532 (>=20% IRHU). Market-rate minimums UNCHANGED as of right, in and out of the zone. No lot-size rule found (existing small-lot/small-number waivers unchanged). Outside the zone: AIRS 10% of units; other IRHU keep old rates.

The 2016 change applied only to affordable and senior units. Under fix 5 the primary outcome is affordable+senior units IF a dated, located, public source exists; see HPD row (dated and located, but starts 2014 and has no senior flag). All new-building units would be 'possibly diluted toward 0'. Decision for the lock.
